error: One country claim carries a two-month period while its value is the full quarter's.
warning_texts: No deterministic rule in audit/check_plan.json binds a claim's declared period or population text to the computation: claims_recomputed filters on the plan's period and never reads the claim's period field, and caveats_declared matches caveat wording only, so CLM-NET-CZ passed all 39 checks of gate_

audit/audit_spec.yaml defines the reported quarter as ending 2025-03-30 rather than 2025-03-31; raw_data/orders.csv has no rows dated 2025-03-31, so no published figure changes, but a reader who takes the period for calendar Q1 may assume otherwise.
summary: All five claim values recompute from raw_data/orders.csv over the spec period 2025-01-01..2025-03-30 and agree with the machine gate. CLM-NET-CZ, however, declares period 2025-01-01..2025-02-28 while its value 13527.24 is the full-period figure; over its declared period the raw data gives 9248.36. The claim's stated period is not the one it was computed on.
